title: sheet
description: One image per pass of the frame, a montage of them, and an index that names each tile. The image is taken at the pass's last call, from the first bound render target of that event. `--list` writes nothing and stops after `shown`, so the last three members are absent there.

outDir.description: where the images went, empty for --list

passesInFrame.description: markers containing at least one call

skipped.description: passes whose target could not be read or written

montage.description: the montage's path, empty when no tile was readable

imageEid.description: the last call inside it: where the image is from

file.description: absent when this pass has no image

hash.description: 16 hex digits: the image's difference hash

note.description: why this pass has no image, or that the image is the depth target because no colour target was bound
